description: Use this when the user looks for a gift: a Christmas gift (prezent na święta, prezent świąteczny), a gift for a child, for an adult, for a family or for company employees (prezent dla pracowników), a gift voucher (bon upominkowy) or a riding pass (karnet) as a gift. Returns the items perfect as a gift from https://horseback.pl/idealne-na-prezent that fit the recipient and the budget: id, name, price, a link to the activity page, an online payment link ("Kup teraz" / Buy now) for items sold online, who the item is for, and the purchase deadline sentence (purchaseDeadline) - tell it to the user. Without recipient the tool returns all gift items. budget_pln is the maximum price of one item in PLN; items without a fixed price (quoted individually) are kept. Do not use for group trips or company team-building days (use get_group_trip_offer) or to take payment.

budget_pln.description: Optional: maximum price of one item in PLN.

language.description: Language of the returned texts: "pl" (Polish, default) or "en" (English). Use the language of the conversation.

recipient.description: Optional: who the gift is for - child, adult, family, or employees (company employees).

name: get_gift_ideas

audience.description: Who the item is for (audience): code and label in the language of the response.

buyNowUrl.description: Online payment link ("Kup teraz" / Buy now), only for items sold online; payment on site is possible too.

id.description: Stable id of the price-list item (pass it in item_ids of get_group_trip_offer).

occasions.description: Occasions the item fits (may be empty): code and label in the language of the response.

price.description: Price as text, e.g. "70 zł / 30 min" or "wycena indywidualna".

priceValue.description: Price in PLN as a number, null when the price is quoted individually or depends on the option.

pageUrl.description: The gift page (all items perfect as a gift).

purchaseDeadline.description: Purchase deadline sentence from the gift page - tell it to the user.

request.description: recipient and budget_pln from the call, echoed back (null where not given).

title: Pomysły na prezent
